description: List support tickets filtered by status (e.g., "open", "closed") and priority (e.g., "1" for urgent). Returns ticket ID, subject, status, priority, and requester.

filter.description: Predefined filter: new_and_my_open, watching, spam, deleted (default: new_and_my_open)

order_by.description: Sort by: created_at, due_by, updated_at, status (default: created_at)

order_type.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

name: freshdesk_list_tickets
